messages:
tina: Noticed a docs glitch in the API reference for /v1/streams. The request example uses `auth_token` and the schema shows `chunk` in the streaming response. Our runtime actually returns `delta` objects and uses standard Bearer auth.

kevin: Good catch. Which file is the example in?

tina: docs/reference/streams.md in the PR branch. PR number is 8487. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8487

leo: Quick checklist: 1) update curl auth header to `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`; 2) replace `chunk` example with `delta` entries and final `done` event; 3) fix OpenAPI param name `stream` -> `streaming` if present.

kevin: I can push the curl and example changes. Minimal example to paste: ```json
{
  "id": "stream_01",
  "events": [
    { "delta": "Hi ", "done": false },
    { "delta": "there", "done": false },
    { "done": true }
  ]
}
```

leo: Also add a short note under "Streaming responses": "Note: streaming responses deliver incremental `delta` objects. Final event is `{ \"done\": true }`. Legacy `chunk` examples are deprecated"

docs-bot: Preview build requested for PR #8487. Status: queued.

kevin: Pushed patch: updated curl header and replaced response block (commit 3c7f8a).

docs-bot: Build started for PR #8487. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-8487--docs.redwood.ai

docs-bot: Build successful for PR #8487. Preview: https://deploy-preview-8487--docs.redwood.ai :white_check_mark:

leo: I updated the OpenAPI rename in a follow-up commit and added an alias note: "`stream` accepted for backwards compatibility; prefer `streaming`." (commit a9d4b2).

kevin: Thanks. I'll merge after CI green on main branch.

tina: Thanks everyone. Added a quick item to the migration guide to call out the preferred `streaming` flag.
